name: The Exorcist
draftAbility: After the second draft pass, you may swap one of your dice with one die belonging to another player. That player may accept or refuse.

progression.left: Strike deals +1 damage when using a 5.

progression.right: Banish destroys 1 Fodder in addition to damage.

name: The Medium
draftAbility: During the first draft, the Medium may ask the group one yes/no question about the draft. Each other player may answer only yes or no.

actions.name: Séance ↻
actions.description: After the Entity action is revealed, change it by ±1.

actions.name: Intercede ↻
actions.description: Change the Entity’s target to any player.

progressionActions.name: Supress ↻
progressionActions.description: Ignore the Entity’s First draft die this round.

progressionActions.name: Rewrite Fate ↻
progressionActions.description: Replace the Entity Second draft die with any value from 1–6.

progression.left: Channel deals +1 Damage when using a 6.
progression.right: Premonition gives +1Ward if both dice are even.

progression.left: Séance may shift the Entity die by up to ±2.
Once per encounter, after the Entity die is known, the Medium may replace it with one of their drafted dice. That die becomes the new Entity action die.

name: The Warden
draftAbility: immediately after another player makes their first draft, the Warden may choose a die from the pool as that player’s second die. That player may accept or refuse it. If accepted, they take it immediately and are skipped during the second draft pass.

actions.name: Interpose ↻
actions.description: You become the target of the Entity’s action if it targets a single player. Gain 1 Ward.

progressionActions.name: Stand Fast ↻
progressionActions.description: Add 2 Ward. If the Entity targets you this round, add 1 additional Ward before damage is resolved.

progressionActions.name: Unbreakable ↻
progressionActions.description: Until the end of the round, if any player that would become Broken, they remain at 1 HP instead.

progression.right: Brace adds +1 additional Ward if R ≤ 2.

progression.left: When you Interpose, reduce the incoming Damage by 1.
progression.right: After using Interpose, deal 1 Damage to the Entity.

progression.left: Abilities do not Exhaust if the Entity damages you this round.
